column1: Introduction to the graph, food, WP, and the core game loop.

column5: Dialogue
Welcome to Level Two — a Type 2 Diabetes management game. Let me be your guide!
This is our Blood Glucose graph. Our current level is 100 mg/dL.
Blood glucose above 200 mg/dL puts real strain on the body. Our goal is to stay below that red line — every single day.

column3: highlight: food:banana + slot:1 (9:00) (pulse) | CTA: drag-arrow food:banana → slot:1 | pauseOnDrop
column5: Time to plan our first meal! Drag the 🍌 Banana to the 9:00 AM slot — let's see how it affects our blood glucose.
column7: pauseOnDrop: game pauses on hover state — placement does NOT commit until step L1D1-6 activates (releasePendingDrop).

column5: When we eat, carbs raise our blood glucose — the more carbs, the higher the blood glucose will rise.
column7: Food remains in hover/preview state during this step. highlightPendingDrop: banana preview cubes blink on graph.

column3: releasePendingDrop | slowBurnAnim | highlight: graph (spotlight) | no backdrop
column5: What a show! The pancreas reacts to rising BG by secreting insulin — pulling our blood sugar right back down.
column7: releasePendingDrop: commits food from L1D1-4. slowBurnAnim: burn animation plays at 3× slow motion. Bubble shown during animation.

column5: Different foods raise glucose at different speeds. It depends on the Glycemic Index — GI for short.
In Level Two, food cards show glucose release speed. Hamburger has a low GI — tagged as Low GI.
column7: highlightGILabel: "Low GI" text on the Burger card blinks cyclically.

column3: highlight: food:burger + slot:6 (2:00 PM) (pulse) | CTA: drag-arrow food:burger → slot:6
column5: Drag the 🍔 Burger to the 2:00 PM slot — let's see how a slow-release food behaves.
Low GI foods release glucose slowly, giving the pancreas more time to respond. They're a safer choice for most situations.
Now hit Submit to see our results!
Look at that! Our pancreas kept the glucose from crossing the 200 mg/dL line — working with our body to stay in the safe zone!
column7: ⚠️ blocksResultsReveal — reveal animation paused until player taps.

column5: Dialogue
That ☀️ icon is your Willpower (WP) — the mental energy it takes to make a healthy choice. In real life, it's what pushes you to do the right thing even when you don't feel like it.
In the game, WP is spent on food and exercise. Healthier options often cost more — let's take a closer look at what's on the menu today.
🍌 Banana has 23g carbs, fast glucose release, and costs just 1 WP.
🍔 Hamburger has 27g carbs, slow glucose release, but costs 2 WP.
And we also have 🍪 Cookie! Try them all out — you can remove a food from a slot by tapping it.
You have enough WP to place everything today. Try different combinations and submit when ready!
Dialogue
A friend shared a slice of 🍕 pizza at lunch — you ate it without thinking twice.
column7: Alt: "A friend shared a slice of 🍕 pizza during your lunch break — you ate it without thinking twice."

column5: Pizza has a moderately high Glycemic Index (GI) — a measure of how quickly food raises blood glucose. High-GI foods cause a faster, sharper spike.
That pizza pushed your glucose above 200 mg/dL — into the danger zone. It happens. Not every day goes to plan.
column7: Alt: "That pizza pushed our glucose above 200 mg/dL — the danger zone. It happens. Some days aren't perfect."

column5: The good news: you still control the rest of the day. Try to keep everything else below 200 and limit the damage.
Place your meals and submit when ready!
